item.title: Rewind Mac app shutting down following Meta’s acquisition of Limitless
item.description: Rewind, which recorded and transcribed everything users saw or heard, is shutting down in two weeks, following Meta’s acquisition of its parent company. Here are the details. more…

item.title: Car Keys are coming to the Wallet app for 13 new vehicle brands soon
item.description: Apple debuted some great new CarPlay features in iOS 26, but the company has more coming for your vehicle soon. Here are the 13 new vehicle brands that Apple says will soon support car keys in the Apple Wallet app. more…

item.title: New report sheds a bit more light on who at Apple has been departing for OpenAI
item.description: A few days ago, Bloomberg’s Mark Gurman reported that OpenAI was poaching Apple hardware engineers “left and right”. Now, a new WSJ piece offers a closer look at some of these departures. more…

item.title: India considers new surveillance measure requiring iPhone A-GPS to stay active 24/7
item.description: Fresh off abandoning its controversial mandate to preload a state-run “security” app on all smartphones, the Indian government may already be heading into an even bigger privacy battle. Here are the details. more…

item.title: House panel questions Apple on apps used to track immigration officers
item.description: Following the controversy that led to Apple removing apps like ICEBlock from the App Store a few months ago, US lawmakers want to know what steps the company is taking to prevent similar tools from returning. Here are the details. more…

item.title: Report: Johny Srouji contemplating leaving Apple, considering career elsewhere
